class.name: CgameRollbackNetcode
class.brief_description: GGPO-style rollback netcode core with input prediction, resimulation and desync detection.
class.description: [CgameRollbackNetcode] runs a deterministic simulation for a fixed set of players and keeps it consistent between peers. Local inputs are applied immediately (optionally delayed by [member input_delay] frames), missing remote inputs are predicted by repeating the last known input, and when a real input arrives that differs from the prediction the simulation is restored from a bounded snapshot ring and resimulated up to the present. Frame semantics: the snapshot for frame [code]f[/code] is the state at the start of frame [code]f[/code], before that frame's inputs. [method advance] simulates the current frame [code]f[/code] to [code]f + 1[/code]. A frame is confirmed once real inputs of every player are known for it and all earlier frames. When the simulation is more than [member max_prediction] frames ahead of the confirmed frame, [method advance] stalls and returns [code]false[/code]. A [member max_prediction] of [code]0[/code] therefore behaves like deterministic lockstep. The step is either a [Callable] with the signature [code]func(state: Dictionary, inputs: Dictionary, dt: float) -> Dictionary[/code] or a native step provider (see [CgamePhysicsRollback]). The step receives a deep copy of the state and may mutate and return it; [code]inputs[/code] maps player id to the input [Dictionary] in sorted player order. The step must be deterministic. Player ids are integers. Transport glue is up to the caller: send the entries of [method drain_outgoing] to the other peers, feed received entries to [method add_remote_input], and optionally exchange [method get_checksum_report] results and feed them to [method add_remote_checksum] to detect desyncs. [codeblock] var net := CgameRollbackNetcode.new() net.setup(step_function, initial_state, [1, 2], [1], 1.0 / 60.0, 2, 8) # Every tick: net.add_local_input(1, {"dx": 1}) for entry in net.drain_outgoing(): send_to_peer(entry) net.advance() [/codeblock]

method.name: add_local_input
method.description: Schedules [param input] for frame (current local frame + [member input_delay]) and returns that frame. The input is also queued for [method drain_outgoing]. Returns [code]-1[/code] if [param player_id] is not a local player.

method.name: add_remote_checksum
method.description: Feeds a checksum reported by a remote peer for [param frame]. If the local checksum of that frame differs once the frame is final, [signal desync_detected] is emitted.

method.name: add_remote_input
method.description: Feeds the real input of a remote player for [param frame]. Duplicates, unknown players and frames older than the retained history are ignored. If the frame was already simulated with a different predicted input, a rollback is scheduled and applied by the next [method process] or [method advance].

method.name: advance
method.description: Applies a pending rollback (if any), then simulates one frame. Returns [code]false[/code] when the prediction window is exhausted ([method is_stalled]) or the step failed.

method.name: checksum_of
method.description: Returns the checksum of the state at the start of [param frame] (from the snapshot ring or the retained checksums of pruned final frames), or [code]0[/code] if it is unknown.

method.name: drain_outgoing
method.description: Returns and clears the queued local inputs as entries [code]{player, frame, input}[/code]. The input delay prefill frames are included.

method.name: get_checksum_report
method.description: Returns new entries [code]{frame, checksum}[/code] for frames that became final since the last call. Pending rollbacks are applied first so that reports never come from mispredicted snapshots.

method.name: get_input_floor
method.description: Returns the first frame for which inputs of [param player_id] are still stored.

method.name: get_pending_rollback
method.description: Returns the earliest frame a scheduled rollback will restore, or [code]-1[/code] if none is pending.

method.name: get_snapshot
method.description: Returns a deep copy of the state snapshot at the start of [param frame], or an empty dictionary if it is not in the ring.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the current simulation state.

method.name: get_used_input
method.description: Returns the input that was actually simulated for [param player_id] at [param frame] (real or predicted), or an empty dictionary.

method.name: has_desync
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one desync was detected.

method.name: has_native_step
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the simulation is stepped by a native step provider instead of a [Callable].

method.name: has_real_input
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a real (not predicted) input is stored for [param player_id] at [param frame].

method.name: has_snapshot
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the snapshot ring holds the state at the start of [param frame].

method.name: has_used_input
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an input for [param player_id] was already simulated at [param frame].

method.name: input_for
method.description: Returns the input that was or will be used for [param player_id] at [param frame]: the real input if known, otherwise the prediction (the last known input is repeated).

method.name: is_stalled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the simulation is [member max_prediction] frames or more ahead of the confirmed frame.

method.name: process
method.description: Resolves a pending rollback caused by late or corrected inputs without simulating a new frame.

method.name: rollback_to
method.description: Restores the snapshot at [param frame] and resimulates up to the current frame. Returns [code]false[/code] if [param frame] is in the future or no longer in the snapshot ring.

method.name: setup
method.description: Resets the netcode. [param step] is the deterministic step function (it may be an invalid [Callable] when a native step provider is attached afterwards, see [method CgamePhysicsRollback.setup_net]). [param players] lists all player ids, [param local_players] the ones controlled on this peer. Local players receive [param input_delay] empty prefill inputs. [param snapshot_capacity] is raised to at least [code]max_prediction + 3[/code].

method.name: snapshot_count
method.description: Returns the number of snapshots currently held in the ring.

method.name: state_checksum
method.description: Returns a checksum of [param state] computed from its serialized representation.

members.member: The highest frame for which real inputs of every player are known for it and all earlier frames, or [code]-1[/code].

signal.name: desync_detected
signal.description: Emitted when the checksum of a final frame differs from the one reported by a remote peer.
